High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Hear Me Baby, Hold Together (V)]] (Virtual Set 1, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 1/Set 1 Light/Hear me baby hold together.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeYm5LcjNNMDltVG8/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Hear me baby hold together.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,592 bytes, SHA-256 <code>a3612cb89fb587325740eee581904121b995220ead912910d00c92fed0c4a3d5</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V1-L-hearmebabyholdtogether-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
